Resolve an identifier against several resources and return the candidates that match. Preferred when the caller has an identifier but not the resource type; use.
Return the API information document. Prefer api_info.get; this exists so every resource satisfies the same floor. Bounded: limit default 25, max 100; the client.
Fetch a company together with the bounded context an agent needs about it. Preferred over four separate list calls when an agent starts work on a company. Retur.
Fetch an article with its company and folder context. Preferred over three separate calls when an agent starts from an article. Returns ArticleContext. Bounded:.
Fetch an asset with the context an agent needs about it. Preferred over four separate calls when an agent starts from an asset. Returns AssetContext. Bounded: e.
Resolve an asset layout from an id, name or slug. Use when the identifier is a layout name or slug; asset_layouts.get is cheaper for a known id. Returns one rec.
Find one password record by its URL slug. Preferred over a full asset passwords scan for a slug lookup. Returns one record: a compact AssetPasswordSummary (pass.
Find one website by its URL slug. Preferred over a full websites scan for a slug lookup. Returns one record: a compact WebsiteSummary (code, message, keyword, ….
Resolve a folder from an id or name, optionally scoped to a company. Use when the identifier is a folder name; folders.get is cheaper for a known id. Returns on.
